<style>
    body {
      font-feature-settings: "cv02", "cv03", "cv04", "cv11";
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    .modal-backdrop {
      background-color: rgba(11, 22, 51, 0.78);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    }
    .btn-premium-orange, .btn-theme {
      background-color: #f16826;
      color: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(241, 104, 38, 0.25);
      transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .btn-premium-orange:hover, .btn-theme:hover {
      background-color: #1b3574;
      color: #ffffff;
      border-color: #1b3574;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -4px rgba(27, 53, 116, 0.4), 0 4px 8px -2px rgba(27, 53, 116, 0.25);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .btn-premium-orange:active, .btn-theme:active {
      background-color: #f16826 !important;
      color: #ffffff !important;
      border-color: #f16826 !important;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(241, 104, 38, 0.4) !important;
      transform: translateY(0) !important;
    }

    .btn-premium-blue {
      background-color: #1b3574;
      color: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid #1b3574;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(27, 53, 116, 0.25);
      transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .btn-premium-blue:hover {
      background-color: #ffffff;
      color: #1b3574;
      border-color: #1b3574;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -4px rgba(27, 53, 116, 0.35), 0 4px 8px -2px rgba(27, 53, 116, 0.2);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* Mega Dropdown CSS with Invisible Hover Bridge & Smooth Falling Transition */
    .mega-dropdown-menu {
      background-color: #0b1633 !important;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
      border-top: 3px solid #f16826 !important;
      box-shadow: 0 24px 64px -16px rgb(11 22 51 / 50%);
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-14px) scale(0.96);
      transform-origin: top center;
      transition: opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), visibility 0.3s;
    }
    .mega-dropdown-menu::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -24px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 24px;
      background: transparent;
    }
    .nav-item-dropdown:hover .mega-dropdown-menu,
    .mega-dropdown-menu:hover,
    .mega-dropdown-menu.is-open {
      visibility: visible !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0) scale(1) !important;
      pointer-events: auto !important;
    }
    .mega-dropdown-menu a {
      color: #ffffff !important;
      transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease;
    }
    .mega-dropdown-menu a:hover {
      background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
      color: #f16826 !important;
    }
    .heading-line-track {
      width: 100%;
      height: 2px;
      background-color: #cbd5e1;
      position: relative;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
    }
    .section-accent-line {
      width: 60px;
      height: 3px;
      background-color: #f16826;
      position: absolute;
      top: -0.5px;
      left: 0;
    }
    .bouncy-card {
      transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 0.4s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }
    .bouncy-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.02);
      box-shadow: 0 22px 35px -10px rgba(11, 22, 51, 0.18), 0 10px 20px -5px rgba(241, 104, 38, 0.2);
      border-color: rgba(241, 104, 38, 0.5);
    }
    .bouncy-btn {
      transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 0.3s ease, background-color 0.2s ease;
    }
    .bouncy-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.04);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(241, 104, 38, 0.4);
    }
  </style>
